artifact_observations.location: White pattern lines on blue fabric
artifact_observations.reasoning: The white lines forming the pattern appear slightly 'painted on' or fused with the fabric texture rather than having the distinct raised feel of embroidery or the sharp edge of high-quality screen printing. There is minor bleeding into the blue weave.

The white trim/binding around the neck hole lacks consistent thickness and structural logic. In some areas, it seems to merge seamlessly into the pattern without a clear separate layer, suggesting slight geometric inconsistency in how the trim is applied.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the neck binding. Does it look like a separate folded piece of fabric sewn on, or does it look like a generated artifact that bleeds into the main body? Check if the pattern lines maintain consistent width and opacity.
